subject: Demon Lord
text: The four Demon Lords have 48 HP each, have no elemental weaknesses, and can be weakened using Lufia's Dew spell.

evidence.quote: ******************************************************************************* BOSS TIME: Demon Lord x4 HP: 48 ea. WEAKNESS: None STRATEGY: Hopefully, Lufia will have learned Dew by now, so have her put it to use. I'd recommend using it in the first two rounds, so that Aguro can finish them off.

subject: Aguro
text: Aguro permanently joins the party after the Demon Lords are defeated.

evidence.quote: Afterwards, Aguro will permanently join your party.

subject: Giant Bat
text: Giant Bats are weak to Lufia's Dew spell.

evidence.quote:
They aren't new, but Giant Bats are weak to Lufia's Dew spell, which can wipe
out an entire group of them.

subject: Kobold
text: Kobolds can drop Mid Arrows.

evidence.quote:
Kobolds can drop Mid Arrows, which will be very 
useful in the near future as well.

subject: Cave to Maberia
text: Crossing the bridge on the upper platform leads to a chest containing a Potion.

evidence.quote:
Climb the rope ladder to the upper platform and cross the bridge where you will
find a chest which contains a POTION.

subject: Cave to Maberia
text: A chest on the next floor after the bridge contains a Power Potion.

evidence.quote:
It's a dead end, but you will find two chests which contain a POTION and POWER
POTION.

subject: Cave to Maberia
text: A hidden Miracle is located in the middle of the swamp.

evidence.quote:
Have the hero cast Float, so you can walk through the swamp unharmed.  In the
middle of it is a hidden MIRACLE.

subject: Cave to Maberia
text: A chest down the path past the swamp contains a Daze Ring that provides DFP+8 and MGR+4.

evidence.quote:
There's nothing to the left, so continue
down the path to a room with a chest which contains a DAZE RING (equip on
Aguro, DFP+8, MGR+4).

subject: Lufia
text: Lufia learns the Strong spell at Level 7.

evidence.quote:
If Lufia has not reached Level 7 yet (which she should w/o level-grinding),
then make sure to finish it off, so that she can learn Strong.

subject: Goblin
text: The three Goblins have 125 HP each and have no elemental weaknesses.

evidence.quote:
BOSS TIME: Goblin x3
HP: 125 ea.
WEAKNESS: None

subject: Inn
text: Resting at the Lorbenia inn costs 20 Gold.

evidence.quote: LORBENIA [LRBN1] Recommended Level: 8 Treasure: Mind Potion, Mid Arrow, Sweet Water Enemies: Bore Worm (Fire), Giant Bat (Water), Giant Newt (Fire), Goblin, Kobold, Mini Demon, Rat, Roozard =-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-= Inn - 20

subject: Lorbenia
text: A hidden Mind Potion can be found behind the weapon and armor shop sign in Lorbenia.

evidence.quote:
Behind the weapon/armor shop sign, you can
find a hidden MIND POTION.

subject: Lorbenia
text: A bookshelf between the equipment shops contains a Mid Arrow.

evidence.quote:
In the lower left corner of the village are the
equipment shops.  Between them is a bookshelf which contains a MID ARROW.

subject: Lorbenia
text: A chest on the second floor of the shopping center in the lower right corner contains Sweet Water.

evidence.quote:
Take the stairs up to
the second floor and in the lower right corner, you'll find a chest which
contains SWEET WATER.

subject: Mini Demon
text: Mini Demons can cast Flash.

evidence.quote:
Of the new enemies, Mini Demons can cast Flash, so
you'll want to take them out quickly.

subject: Inn
text: Resting at the Grenoble inn costs 40 Gold.

evidence.quote: GRENOBLE [GNBL1] Recommended Level: 8 Treasure: Potion, Speed Potion, Spell Potion Enemies: Bore Worm (Fire), Giant Bat (Water), Giant Newt (Fire), Goblin, Kobold, Mini Demon, Rat, Roozard =-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-= Inn - 40

subject: Grenoble
text: Examining the bookshelf in the weapon shop in Grenoble yields a Potion.

evidence.quote:
Check out the weapon shop and examine the
bookshelf which contains a POTION.

subject: Grenoble
text: A bookshelf in the upper left house in Grenoble contains a Speed Potion.

evidence.quote:
Walk around to the upper left house, where you should pay the man 50 Gold to
learn about "the rumor".  Examine the bookshelf behind him which contains a
SPEED POTION (save for later).

subject: Grenoble
text: A hidden Spell Potion can be found in the flowers between two trees behind Grenoble.

evidence.quote:
Follow the secret passage around to the back of
town where you can find a hidden SPELL POTION in the flowers between the two
trees.

subject: Old Cave
text: Accessing the second floor of the Old Cave requires at least one party member to be at Level 5, with each subsequent floor requiring 5 additional levels.

evidence.quote:
The way the Old Cave works is it
is composed of 7 floors.  In order to access the second floor, at least one
character in your party needs to be at Level 5.  For each subsequent floor you
want to access, you need a character with 5 more experience levels.

subject: Old Cave
text: On the second level of the Old Cave, the chest to the left contains a Hi Magic.

evidence.quote:
On the second level, the chest to the right is empty and the one to the left
contains a HI MAGIC.

subject: Old Cave
text: A chest on the path on the second level of the Old Cave contains a Potion.

evidence.quote: Walk around to the next chest which contains a POTION.

subject: Old Cave
text: The chest at the intersection on the second level of the Old Cave contains an Antidote.

evidence.quote: The chest at the intersection contains an ANTIDOTE.

subject: Old Cave
text: A hidden Ex Potion is located straight down from the right empty chest along the lower path when using Float.

evidence.quote:
Take the lower path to two
chests which are empty.  Cast Float, then go straight down from the chest on
the right to find a hidden EX POTION.

subject: Old Cave
text: Down the hall on the second level, one of the three chests contains a Potion.

evidence.quote:
Down the hall, open the three remaining
chests which are empty, contain a POTION, and SLEEP ARROW (save for later).

subject: Old Cave

Give the Old Man the Fairy Kiss to receive a LETTER and to learn that you must head to the Northwest Tower

subject: Secret Map

evidence.quote:
Also, exchange the Secret Map you found for 500 GOLD from the lady

evidence.quote:
If you run low on MP,
don't be afraid to use a Hi Magic, as you'll find one and Red Magi drop them.
